title: Shield space and decking.
officialText:
The space between the shield and the perimeter of the opening in the floor under
construction and also between the shield and the perimeter of the opening in the floor next below shall be decked over with 2-
inch (51 mm) or heavier planking covered with plywood or sheet metal so as to make the decking smoke tight. At the termination
of the ladders, the opening in the floor shall be covered completely with 2-inch (51 mm) planking or other material of equivalent
strength.
